summary: Web application with secure username/password authentication system
architectural_notes: Username/password authentication system replacing Internet Identity
Password hashing required for security (no plain text storage)

existing_features.title: Replace hardcoded admin credentials in frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts with a secure registration system that allows creating new admin accounts
Implement secure session management with token-based authentication that expires after a reasonable period
Update AdminLogin component in frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx to include registration UI and connect to the new backend authentication system

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement secure user registration system with custom account creation
Add password hashing (no plain text storage)
Implement password hashing in the backend using SHA-256 or Motoko's native crypto functions to never store passwords in plain text
Create backend user management functions in backend/main.mo for registering users, authenticating with hashed passwords, and managing user accounts
